item.title: github: Copilot code review can now approve pull requests
item.description:
Copilot code review can now indicate when a pull request is ready for approval, and repository admins can authorize it to approve the PR. The approval capability is disabled by default.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in VS Code, August 2026 releases
item.description:
VS Code v1.132 through v1.135, released in August 2026, add improvements to GitHub Copilot workflows focused on organizing agent sessions, reviewing changes, and navigating longer conversations. The changelog also mentions updates to Agent Host, but the provided excerpt does not include the details.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Resolution reasons and expanded capabilities
item.description:
Copilot code review now supports two additional pull request types: PRs authored by bots (including Copilot cloud agent) and very large pull requests. GitHub also added resolution reasons for code review outcomes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review effort levels are generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot code review effort levels are now generally available. Lite and Balanced let you choose review depth based on the complexity and risk of the code change.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Stacked pull requests are now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has put stacked pull requests into public preview. The feature lets users split a larger change into an ordered series of smaller, reviewable pull requests.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Agent skills and MCP now generally available
item.description:
Copilot code review now generally supports agent skills and MCP servers for all Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise users. These features have moved from public preview to general availability.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Customization and configurability improvements
item.description:
Copilot code review now supports a firewall, custom setup steps, and independent runner configurations. It also reads custom instructions from the head branch to make testing and validation easier.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Mobile: Fix pull request comments with Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Mobile now lets you select “Fix with Copilot” from Copilot code review pull request comments. The action is available in the pull request’s main view and uses the Copilot cloud agent.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Restrict who can dismiss reviews in rulesets
item.description:
GitHub repository rulesets now support restricting who can dismiss pull request reviews. The feature is generally available and lets you control which users can clear review requirements.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: k8s: Open source maintainership in the age of AI
item.description:
Kubernetes says AI-assisted contributions are welcome, but maintainers must keep human accountability, transparency, and verification at the center. The community is also testing AI review tools such as Copilot and CodeRabbit to help with pull request review and maintainer workload.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Analysis depth and efficiency updates
item.description:
Copilot code review now uses built-in file exploration tools from the Copilot CLI and SDK. GitHub says this improves review cost efficiency without changing the existing workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: AGENTS.md support and UI improvements
item.description:
Copilot code review now reads repository-level AGENTS.md files and adds a Request button to make it easier to ask Copilot for a review on draft pull requests. GitHub says these updates are generally available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: New configurations and controls
item.description:
GitHub added new ways to configure Copilot code review, including organization runner controls, support for Copilot content exclusion, and removal of the repository custom instructions character limit.

  • Source: GitHub
